title: Aurora rumoured at RAF Machrihanish
summary: Nick Cook tells of Aurora rumoured at RAF Machrihanish, about late 1980s-1990s at RAF Machrihanish, Scotland, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there were rumors it was based out of the UK for a while at a remote Scottish base called RAF Machrihanish.

plain: Nick Cook, a British aviation journalist, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that there were rumours about Aurora, a supposed secret American aircraft, in the late 1980s and 1990s. He says it was rumoured to be based for a while at RAF Machrihanish, a remote Royal Air Force base in Scotland. If true, a secret advanced aircraft would have been flying from British soil.
